summary.name: SLICK
summary.one_liner: SLICK is Meta's internal dedicated SLO store for centralizing service-level indicator and objective definitions, storing long-term metric data, and generating dashboards and reports.
use_cases: Centralizing SLO definitions across many services
Finding a team's reliability status quickly
Generating periodic SLO performance reports for reliability reviews
Backfilling metric data and testing config changes via CLI
summary.what_it_does: SLICK lets service owners define SLIs and SLOs in a unified way, either through an editing UI or a config file written in a DSL. Hourly data pipelines pull SLI time series at one-minute granularity from monitoring datasets and store them in a sharded MySQL database with up to two years of retention. It generates per-service dashboards and a searchable index of onboarded services. It also posts periodic SLO performance reports to internal groups and provides a CLI for backfilling data, generating reports, and testing config changes.
notable: Per-minute metric granularity with up to two years of retention
Hourly data pipelines with data quality checks using deterministic test time series
Integrates SLOs into on-call tooling and incident declaration criteria
caveats: Internal Meta tool; not publicly available as a product
Page describes Meta's internal system and does not document external installation or licensing
Planned future work (dependency-aware SLOs, improvement suggestions, scaling) is not yet delivered per the page
